title: Understanding K-means Clustering
text: K-means clustering is an iterative algorithm that aims to partition a dataset into K distinct, non-overlapping subgroups (clusters).

title: What is Inertia in Clustering?
text: Inertia is a measure of how well the clusters are formed. It is the sum of squared distances of samples to their closest cluster center.

title: Convergence of K-means
text: K-means clustering can converge to a local minimum, which may not be the global minimum of inertia.

title: Evaluating K-means Clustering
text: Given that K-means can converge to a local minimum, it will [blank] find the optimal clustering in terms of inertia.
